t: This is Falkland Road, a street in the London Borough of Camden. It takes its name from Lucius Cary, the second Viscount Falkland. He was an English writer and politician who sat in the House of Commons from 1640 to 1642. In the Civil War he fought on the Royalist side, and he was killed in action at the First Battle of Newbury in 1643. So the name here remembers a writer turned soldier who died for the King's cause.
